title: Regression: search debounce, filter chips, Column Selection per user and New Inventory Part still work
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin; a second login (b) "QA PL Create&Edit" for the per-user check. Parts QAPL-T1…T5 and QAPL-CAP-001 present. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory (Active tab) type QAPL-T in the search without pausing, then stop typing.
  2. Clear the search, add a filter chip (Category, Bin Location or Supply) from the filter bar, then remove it.
  3. Open Column Selection, untick one column (toggle_column_*), reload the page, then log in as (b) and open /parts/inventory.
  4. As (a), click New Inventory Part (button_new_inventory_part), then close the dialog without saving.
  5. ⋮ > Cycle count; type a new count for QAPL-CAP-001; click Print, then Cancel.
  6. ⋮ > Cycle count again; type a new count for QAPL-CAP-001 and click Save.
custom_expected:
1. No list request is sent while typing; one GET /api/inventory/parts with the search is sent about 750 ms after the last keystroke; QAPL-T1…T5 are listed.
  2. The chip shows and the list narrows to matching parts; removing it restores the full list.
  3. The column hides at once and is still hidden for (a) after the reload; for (b) the column still shows (the choice is saved per user). Re-tick it as (a) afterwards.
  4. The New Inventory Part dialog opens; closing it saves nothing.
  5. The count controls replace the ⋮ menu; after typing, the count-changes indicator text_count_changes_available shows; Print produces the count sheet; Cancel ends count mode and QAPL-CAP-001 keeps its quantity.
  6. The count is saved, count mode ends and QAPL-CAP-001 shows the counted quantity.
